findings.text: mergePersistentFlags and the new LocalFlags no longer fold in the global pflag.CommandLine flags for the root command. The old code did this. Flags added with `pflag.CommandLine.AddGoFlagSet(...)` (glog, for example) are no longer parsed or listed, so passing `--v=2` now fails with 'unknown flag'.

addToLocal skips any flag whose name is in parentsPflags. A child that defines its own local or persistent flag with the same name as a parent's persistent flag (for example `--config`) is dropped from LocalFlags. The same name also appears in InheritedFlags, so help and usage show the parent's flag and omit the child's.

iflags, lflags and parentsPflags are cached and only ever added to, never rebuilt. If a flag is added to a parent after the first InheritedFlags or LocalFlags call, or a flag is removed or replaced, the child keeps returning stale entries. Previously a fresh FlagSet was built on every call.

0.reason: The patch deletes both places that folded flag.CommandLine into the root (the persistent-flag merge in mergePersistentFlags and the root-only merge in LocalFlags) and adds no replacement, so global pflag/goflag flags such as glog's --v are no longer merged into the command's flags or listed.

2.reason: Every call re-runs updateParentsPersistentFlags, mergePersistentFlags and the VisitAll passes over the parents, so flags added to a parent later are picked up; pflag has no way to remove flags, so the removal case cannot happen.
